title: to support the society and the economy recover
columns:
Recovery:
• 59% PBT growth from Ksh.14.3B in
2020 to Ksh.22.6 in 2021.
• 8% Balance Sheet growth, from
Ksh.537 B in 2020 to Ksh. 580 B in
2021.

USD 300M - In partnership with IFC and
Phillips toward Health area Sector.
USD 85M - We secured USD 85 Million
from our long-term funding partners
towards supporting our customers in the
MSME segment, the health sector and
Businesses undertaking Climate-Smart
Projects.

Ksh.70.5B - The amount of credit
advanced through our E-Credit solution
in 2021.
